Current assessment — 2026-10-05

Reviewed against local main 7057a8d5a2d898c1bfb528a28f3f635dda639b8b, origin/main 568ce108 (local main clean, 112 ahead/0 behind at audit; no push).

Where we are: VeryInflated is implemented and the source-bound fsLR family landing is recorded locally; the body's missing-kind premise is obsolete. Current native candidate projection still shows an old pending phase despite the landing notes, so tracker candidate history and Git ancestry must be reconciled before broad closure.

Fresh context: Yes: engineering acceptance audit.

Next action: Audit remaining asset/family/mask/topology/correspondence criteria against actual main and locked TemplateFlow receipts; bind a dated acceptance record. Keep mapping, visual preference and default/consumer admission separate.

Evidence: modules/surface/.../SurfaceTags.scala; landing-verification note 2026-10-01; live candidate projection; docs/verification/consolidation-20261005.md.

This is a tracker/source/retained-evidence assessment, not a new experiment or test run. Existing acceptance criteria and owner decisions remain binding; dated source-state statements below are superseded where this assessment explicitly corrects them. Status, priority, assignee, claims and dependency edges are unchanged.

---

Previous scope and history (acceptance retained)

Outcome: admit one corresponding bilateral fsLR 32k family while preserving anatomical, display, vertex and mask identities. Owner: ScalaFIM surface/surface-view; atlas supplies descriptors and optional labels. P1 provider integration.

Shared discovery tags: standard-surface-qa, fslr-32k. Canonical plan: docs/plans/fslr32k-standard-surface-qualification.md.

Scope and acceptance:
1. Consume TemplateFlow4s-resolved paths/bytes and provenance through existing ScalaFIM GIFTI/resource APIs. Do not put downloading in atlas or duplicate an acquisition client. Confirm 32,492 vertices per hemisphere, valid finite coordinates/triangles/winding, source metadata and exact geometry/topology identities. Diagnose malformed input; never silently repair or smooth it.
2. Establish ordered correspondence among midthickness, inflated and veryinflated from pinned source provenance and index/topology checks. Equal vertex counts or equal connectivity alone do not prove anatomical correspondence. Reject shuffled order, wrong hemisphere/density/mask and mixed-source families. Record ordered triangle and vertex-axis fingerprints; preserve source bytes and immutable coordinates.
3. Represent VeryInflated explicitly through the existing display-kind/resource model, codecs, saved identities and exhaustive matches. Current primary SurfaceKind has Inflated but no VeryInflated. Reconcile the actual admitted provider closure and existing mesh4s migration before implementation; do not silently adopt a branch or create parallel identities.
4. Interpret the medial-wall label table explicitly; record included/excluded counts and a boundary-face policy. Keep the original vertex axis and mesh topology. Mask scalar sampling/display and picking consistently without renumbering vertices. Distinguish medial wall from missing/out-of-volume values and valid zero.
5. Switching display realization changes coordinates and derived normals only; scalar values, coverage, vertex IDs, sampling coordinates and projection receipt remain identical. The midthickness anatomical frame is independently declared and may be unqualified for volume mapping. No nonlinear anatomical transform may deform inflated/veryinflated display coordinates.
6. Minimal fixtures exercise correspondence refusal, both kinds' serialization/roundtrip, mask polarity/boundary faces and invariant fields. Shared changes pass relevant JVM+JS suites and warning-clean compile gate. Full-family file admission has source-bound receipts.

Paths: modules/surface/.../SurfaceTags.scala and existing GIFTI/resource contracts; modules/surface-view shared resource/identity/codecs; modules/atlas/.../StandardAtlases.scala only if a real descriptor gap exists. Reuse current implementations. No mapping/reference implementation is assigned here: active native mapping issue bd-01M35BHNDCHM6YXCKYX0544TP3 owns modules/surface/.../reference and numerical qualification.

External prerequisite: TemplateFlow4s fsLR asset receipt (cross-store path/ID linked in follow-up). The local visual court depends on this admitted family. Mapping audit can proceed independently; real-data integration awaits its qualified exact-space route. No sampling kernel, smoothing default, app UI or publication is in scope.
